message.subject: Collaboration proposal with EDXSO
message.email_body: Ethical Explorers, your video on Kali NetHunter Pro on a laptop caught our attention. EDXSO works with schools on academic outcomes and leadership. We want to propose an exploratory UGC-style tutorial on practical technology workflows for educators, with format and terms open for discussion. This helps teachers introduce useful tech concepts safely to students. Would you be interested in exploring the idea together?
